name: RequirementTraceabilityAgent
description: Static, code-only traceability (runs in parallel with browser execution): per acceptance criterion, batched query expansion, hybrid code retrieval over the knowledge graph, verifier sample A (temp 0.2) plus sample B (temp 0.7, concurrent with A's follow-up retrieval, skipped when A is decisive), deterministic citation and wiring validation, and a coverage-aware absence protocol. LLM failures yield llm_unavailable (llm_failed), never silent insufficient evidence. Returns a static_trace that apply_runtime_evidence (tools.py) later re-decides with runtime results.

inputs.name: requirements
inputs.description: Requirements with acceptance criteria (and DB ids)

inputs.name: repo_coverage
inputs.description: Fetch coverage from RepoFetchAgent (truncation blocks not_implemented)

outputs.name: criterion_verdicts
outputs.description: Static verdict, strength, credit, agreement, rationale, llm_failed, samples per criterion

outputs.name: evidence_items
outputs.description: Static/structural evidence rows with validated citations

outputs.name: traced_requirements
outputs.description: Copies of the requirements with rolled-up verdict, score, legacy status and llm_unavailable count

outputs.name: static_trace
outputs.description: JSON per-criterion verifier samples, evidence and negative search; input of tools.apply_runtime_evidence

outputs.name: llm_failures
outputs.description: Criteria not evaluated because the LLM verifier failed (verdict llm_unavailable); status is partial when > 0
